guess_property_metadata: guess metadata for all properties in a list of ASE atoms objects including info and calculator results
guess_target_metadata: guess whether a target property is per-atom or per-image and if it is intensive or extensive
target_extensive: check if a property scales with system size by analyzing per-atom normalized standard deviation
target_per_atom: determine if a target array has its first dimension proportional to the number of atoms
target_constant_shape: check if all target samples have the same shape regardless of varying atom counts
